description: PAID ($0.0045 USDC via x402, paid automatically). What a Base address owns, in one call: the ETH balance read from the chain, every ERC-20 it holds with balance, market price and USD value, and a USD total. Tokens with no market price are listed but not counted; tokens the explorer flags (airdropped spam imitating a real token) are listed, flagged and NOT counted. Send no body to get the wallet that pays. Very large wallets can time out (502, not charged). Any answer the tool cannot produce is >= 400 and is NOT charged.

address.description: A 40-hex EVM address (0x…) on Base. Omit the whole body to get the paying wallet

payment.description: Base64 of a single x402 v2 PaymentPayload you signed yourself. OPTIONAL: with AGENT_PRIVATE_KEY set, this tool pays automatically and you never need it. Use it to pay from a DIFFERENT wallet, or when no key is configured — call once without it to get the 402 (its body carries `howToPay.payloadTemplate`, the exact envelope to sign), then call again with it. When set it is sent as-is as the PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header; no local signing and no price ceiling are applied.
